title: I turned my one-shot GTA into an 8-player multiplayer browser game
author: ledniv
selftext:
Hi everyone! A few days ago, I posted about making a one-shot GTA game with Astra. Redditors suggested I add multiplayer, weapons, and pedestrians, so I did!

You can play it in your browser here:

[https://gta.nitzan.games](https://gta.nitzan.games)

It's 8-player matches, first to 10 kills wins. It autofills with bots if there aren't enough players, but if a player joins, they replace a bot.

I’d love to hear what I should add or change!

If you want to check out the one-shot game, you can play it here: [https://nitzan.games/OneShotGTA.html](https://nitzan.games/OneShotGTA.html)
